metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2019 · Svaha: The Sixth Finger
metas.description: Pastor Park works to expose suspicious religious groups. He's hired to look into the cult group Deer Mount. Meanwhile, Police Captain Hwang investigates a murder case and the main suspect is a member of the Deer Mount cult.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2020 · The Call
metas.description: Two people live in different times. Seo-Yeon lives in the present and Young-Sook lives in the past. One phone call connects the two, and their lives are changed irrevocably.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2022 · Project Wolf Hunting
metas.description: Follows dangerous criminals on a cargo ship who are transported from the Philippines to South Korea, as they unleash a sinister force after an escape attempt leads to a riot.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1998 · The Quiet Family
metas.description: A family opens a mountain inn where their first guest commits suicide. Suddenly all their guests befall horrible fates.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1960 · The Housemaid
metas.description: A composer and his wife are thrown into turmoil when a housemaid becomes more than they bargained for.
